entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: A changeling human planeswalker from Dominaria, founding Sage of Minorad and for a time Mistress of House Scarlet.

entities.name: Minorad
entities.description: Place whose sages count years from the summit.

entities.name: House Scarlet
entities.description: House of which Liana was for a time Mistress.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Whose teachings inspired the summit of mages and planeswalkers.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Villain who threatened Liana with the Golgothian Sylex and forced her into becoming his lover.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Ravidel used to threaten the summit.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Person around whom Ravidel had plans; Liana helped him escape.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: Ravidel's spellsquire who mind-controlled Liana and died in the attack on Arathoxia.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: Place from which Liana helped Jared escape.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: Site of an attack in which the Vizier died.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Person whom Liana's potion was meant to help.

entities.name: The Abyss
entities.description: Place into which Liana lured Ravidel.

entities.name: Corundis
entities.description: Place where Jared and Kristina escaped.

entities.name: Moxen
entities.description: Liana's three Moxen, which Ravidel took to create the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Planeswalkers' War
entities.description: War started by the Mox Beacon.

events.summary: Ravidel interrupts a summit of mages and planeswalkers, threatening them with the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: This gathering was interrupted by Ravidel

events.summary: The Scarlet Vizier mind-controls Liana, forcing her to become Ravidel's lover.
events.quote: cast a mind control spell on her, so she couldn't fight Ravidel and was forced to become his lover instead

events.summary: Liana helps Jared escape Castle Melmereth.
events.quote: she helped Jared escape Castle Melmereth

events.summary: After the Vizier dies at Arathoxia, Liana allies with Jared and detonates Ravidel's artifacts.
events.quote: Liana allied herself with Jared and detonated all of Ravidel's artifacts

events.summary: Liana lures Ravidel into the Abyss so Jared and Kristina can escape to Corundis; she dies in the battle.
Ravidel takes her three Moxen to create the Mox Beacon that starts the Planeswalkers' War.
events.quote: Ravidel took her three Moxen to create the Mox Beacon that started the Planeswalkers' War

relations.note: Opposed him despite being forced to be his lover.
relations.quote: She was not loyal to Ravidel by any means and did whatever she could to oppose him.
